title: Hoop Rolling Trundle
tagline: Roll, steer and race a hoop down the road.
description: An old children's street game, trundling a hoop down a village lane, as a course racer. Push, brake and lean a rolling hoop with one finger through striped gates, bends, cobbles, mud, puddles, hills and plank bridges against three rivals. Eight courses, Practice, Watch and Learn, an in-app Rules book, portrait and landscape play, synthesised sound, no ads.
howToPlay: Hold your finger below the hoop to push; raise it above the hoop to brake.
Slide your finger left or right of the hoop to lean and steer toward it.
Keep the balance dot in the green: a slow or over-steered hoop falls.
Roll through the middle of each gate for a Perfect; posts knock you off line.
Brake before tight bends, cobbles and plank bridges, then push on.
Watch and Learn rolls the course for you and thinks before each section. Pause it any time.
On a keyboard: Space pushes, Down brakes, Left and Right steer, P pauses.
